mapper.insert: insert into team_media( filename, relative_path, mime_type, file_size, uploader_id, team_id, related_type, related_id, status, reject_reason, created_at ) VALUES ( #{filename}, #{relativePath}, #{mimeType}, #{fileSize}, #{uploaderId}, #{teamId}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, #{status}, #{rejectReason}, NOW() )
mapper.select: select * from team_media where id = #{id} for update
select * from team_media where team_id = #{teamId} and status <> 'ARCHIVED'

select m.* from team_media m where m.team_id = #{teamId} and m.status = 'PUBLISHED' and ( m.related_type IS NULL OR m.related_type = '' OR ( m.related_type = 'IMAGE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_page_images img WHERE img.id = m.related_id AND img.team_id = m.team_id AND img.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) ) OR ( m.related_type = 'WORD' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM team_page_word wrd WHERE wrd.id = m.related_id AND wrd.team_id = m.team_id AND wrd.status = 'PUBLISHED' ) ) ) order by m.created_at desc
select * from team_media where related_type = #{relatedType} and related_id = #{relatedId}
mapper.update: update team_media set status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, updated_at = NOW() where id = #{id}

update team_media set status = 'ARCHIVED', updated_at = NOW() where id in
#{id}
mapper.select: select id from team_media where status = 'ARCHIVED' and updated_at < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{retentionDays} DAY) order by updated_at asc, id asc limit #{limit}
